description: next 16.1.6 has 2 critical advisories (incl. AVIF Image Optimization RCE, and next.config.ts enables image/avif); floor is >=16.3.8 or latest 16.3.x/16.4.x. Also sharp >=0.35.5 (breaking minor) and transitive highs (postcss, nanoid, browserslist, picomatch, braces, brace-expansion, flatted, js-yaml) via upgrade or overrides. Interim: drop image/avif from images.formats.

In-memory rate limiter is per instance and keys on the first x-forwarded-for hop, with a shared 'unknown' bucket; move to a durable store or Vercel Firewall rate limit with a trusted client IP. Also decide input length caps (name, message, body size) and an idempotency key.

No security headers (CSP, HSTS, frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy). A CSP needs nonces or hashes for the inline theme, entrance and lang scripts and the JSON-LD.

Project cards (WorkSection and the next-project block in ProjectContent) are div onClick: not keyboard reachable or crawlable (WCAG 2.1.1). Needs a link/button that still drives navigateToProject with the element ref.
Server HTML has no lang attribute; it is set only by an inline script in app/[locale]/layout.tsx (WCAG 3.1.1). Fix needs <html lang={locale}> in the locale layout or root params after a Next upgrade.

react-hooks/set-state-in-effect error on the pre-paint first-visit flip. Cause-level fix is deriving first-visit from the data-entrance attribute the head script sets, with a latch because the attribute is removed after the entrance; needs a design pass. Blocks a clean lint.
ESLint 9 is end of life. Moving to ESLint 10 needs eslint-plugin-react, jsx-a11y and import to declare v10 peer support first (planning).
Consider adopting knip (pnpm add -D knip, knip.json) to find unused files, exports and dependencies through the module graph.

Client components call getContent(locale), which pulls both content JSON files (blur placeholders, project descriptions) into the client bundle. Passing slices from server components is a restructure across several components (planning).
hexToRgb is duplicated in DitherField (object, fallback 250,250,250) and GrainOverlay (tuple, fallback 0,0,0). Unifying changes the failure-path colour.
No Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header, and HSTS has no preload directive. Adding either changes behaviour (preload is hard to undo).
Magnetic calls setState on every mousemove. Motion values (useSpring x/y) would avoid re-renders, but useSpring bypasses MotionConfig reducedMotion, so it needs a usePrefersReducedMotion jump path.
Informational hero and gallery videos have no text alternative. Each needs an authored description in both locales, or at least an aria-label from the project title.
The Back control is a button that calls router.push, so it behaves as a link. It is a button for the animated exit; making it a link changes behaviour.
scripts/convert-to-webp.ts has no package.json script and no mention in README or CLAUDE.md; document it or confirm it is a deliberate one-off.
